literal.prompt: Какой крупный остров в Арктике известен ледниковым щитом, покрывающим большую часть его территории?

sixLiteralCanonicalGroups.individualGround: PASS: NSIDC L78 says Earth now has only two ice sheets, one covering most Greenland and another across Antarctica. L83 says Greenland sheet covers about80percent. NOAA L142/L247 supplies Greenland Arctic-region constraint. This asks majority-sheet-covered island, not maximum island area. Baffin/Ellesmere/Iceland are real northern glaciated islands but scattered glaciers/ice caps are not a second whole-predicate key. NSIDC L86-L91 expressly distinguishes caps from ice sheets; Antarctica is a continent, not an offered island. Unique current key0.

sixLiteralCanonicalGroups.literal: Это Гренландия. Её ледниковый щит покрывает около 80% острова и занимает примерно 1,7 млн км².
sixLiteralCanonicalGroups.individualGround: PASS: NSIDC L83 explicitly gives about80percent and1.7million square kilometres for Greenland Ice Sheet; current explanation preserves approximations, not total island area,100percent cover or a newly dated measurement.

sixLiteralCanonicalGroups.literal: На Земле сейчас два ледниковых щита: Гренландский и Антарктический.
sixLiteralCanonicalGroups.individualGround: PASS: NSIDC L78 explicitly gives two existing sheets, Greenland and Antarctic. Global count and Antarctic counterpart add facts beyond requested Arctic-island identity. L82 regional East/West Antarctic subdivisions do not contradict source’s conventional two-sheet count.

sixLiteralCanonicalGroups.literal: Фоксов бассейн лежит у западного побережья Баффиновой Земли, в канадском Нунавуте.
sixLiteralCanonicalGroups.individualGround: PASS: NASA Foxe Basin main article L267 places basin off western Baffin coast in Nunavut/Canada; L266-L271 distinguishes surrounding seasonal sea ice from land ice. Independent own Baffin location fact, no Greenland property transferred.

sixLiteralCanonicalGroups.literal: Несколько отступающих ледников на острове Элсмир питают долину Ооблойах талой водой летом.
sixLiteralCanonicalGroups.individualGround: PASS: NASA Ellesmere full main account L266-L274, especiallyL268, names several retreating glaciers from Krieger Mountains providing summer meltwater to Oobloyah Valley. Note preserves plurality,valley and summer condition; it gives ecological relation from2013scene without inventing current retreat rate or extent.

sixLiteralCanonicalGroups.literal: В Исландии ледниковые шапки и ледники лежат над действующими вулканами.
sixLiteralCanonicalGroups.individualGround: PASS: NASA Iceland full main article L264-L271 describes icecaps/glaciers above active volcanoes and specific icecaps/subglacial volcano. Current note preserves caps/glaciers rather than upgrading Iceland to majority-covered present ice sheet.
